{{Quote|I've seen thousands drop dead from Tarisian Toxic Flu. Watched cities vaporize from proto-isotope bombs. Nothing like this. Thought it would be dead silent.|HMC-10|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tarisian Toxic Flu''' was a type of flu that originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Ziost]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[HMC-10]] had witnessed thousands of beings [[Death/Legends|die]] from the Toxic Flu.
